description: Least-privilege capability set for the FBUploadPro desktop shell (spec 145 §6.3). Custom bridge commands are Rust invoke handlers, not plugin JS APIs, so they need no capability entries. The web layer never calls the fs/shell/http plugins directly — there are deliberately NO unbounded fs read/write, shell execute, or renderer HTTP permissions here. Dialog and opener permissions exist only for the plugin-backed dialog/open flows the shell itself drives.
